name: phishing-credential-theft
description: Finance analyst phished via AiTM page; attacker replays session token from Nigeria, grants OAuth app, creates forwarding rule. Expected: fully autonomous containment.

alert.title: Impossible travel: j.alrashid signed in from Lagos, NG 34 minutes after Riyadh, SA
alert.description: Two successful sign-ins for the same user from locations 4,900 km apart within 34 minutes. Second sign-in was non-interactive with an MFA claim carried in the token.
